about: AGGREGATE (docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 16; ADR-0047, 2026-10-10): admitted while a Sheet cannot hide a row, so options 1, 3, 5 and 7 give what 0, 2, 4 and 6 give. A cell is nested when its Formula, or for a cell of a Spill Range its Anchor's, calls SUBTOTAL or AGGREGATE anywhere in its text, as the seventeenth Windows run read Excel's answers (SH-68): options 0 to 3 pass over it, and options 4 to 7 count its Value. Function numbers for functions the engine does not support (13, 16-19) are #VALUE!. From the fifth argument on, something that can never be a Reference is refused on entry.
